values.title: I figure things out.
values.description: At Oracle I was handed a tool with almost no documentation. I went straight to the source, studied it properly, and became the person others came to when they were stuck.

values.title: Full-circle or nothing.
values.description: I don't ship unless every layer is solid — the data model, the API, the integration, the UI, and the polish.

values.title: API design is UX design.
values.description: How data is structured and served shapes how the UI behaves. I treat API contracts as first-class design decisions.

values.title: I translate tech for people.
values.description: Whether working with medical staff or small business owners, I turn complex decisions into plain language — and their needs into software that actually fits.

values.title: Security is a default.
values.description: Validation, auth flows, rate limiting, RBAC. Baked in from the first line, not bolted on at the end.

values.title: I perform under pressure.
values.description: I have over 100 singing competition awards and performed on television. Showing up when the stakes are high, staying focused when things are not going your way — that has always just been part of how I operate.

values.title: Independence with collaboration where it matters.
values.description: I move fast on my own and make decisions without needing to be managed. But I know when to align, when to ask, and when to bring people in.

values.title: Pixel-perfect attention to detail.
values.description: 1px off? I see it. And fix it. Transitions, spacing, states — they all matter.
